entries.toelichting: North-African people (2Chr 12:3; 16:8; Nah 3:9; Dan 11:43). English convention: Libyans.
Son of Shem (Gen 10:22; 1Chr 1:17; Isa 66:19; Eze 27:10; 30:5). English convention: Lud.
Ni: be-joined (Gen 29:34; Num 18:2,4; Esth 9:27; Ps 83:9; Ecc 8:15; Isa 14:1; 56:3,6; Jer 50:5; Dan 11:34; Zech 2:11). Hyphenated.
Qal/Hi: lend, borrow (Deut 28:12,44; 1Sam 1:28 (?); 2Kgs 4:3; Neh 5:4; Ps 37:21,26; 112:5; Prov 19:17; 22:7; Isa 24:2). Hyphenated.
Old name of Bethel (Gen 28:19; 35:6; 48:3; Josh 16:2; 18:13; Judg 1:23,26). English convention: Luz.
Moabite ascent (Isa 15:5; Jer 48:5). English convention: Luhith.
Nephew of Abraham (Gen 11:27,31; 12:4,5; 13:1-14; 14:12,16; 19:1-36; Deut 2:9,19; Ps 83:8). English convention: Lot.
Place near Mount Ephraim (Neh 3:12 ?). English convention: Lush.
Site of Samson's victory (Judg 15:9-19). English convention: Lehi.
Brother of Goliath (1Chr 20:5). English convention: Lahmi.
Town in Judah (Josh 15:40). English convention: Lahmas.
Ex 3:9; Deut 26:7; 1Kgs 22:27; 2Chr 18:26; 2Kgs 13:4; Job 36:15; Ps 42:9; 43:2; 44:24; Isa 30:20. Standard concordant.
Pi/Hithp: speak-softly, enchant (2Sam 12:19; Ps 41:7; 58:5; Ecc 10:11). Hyphenated.
Son of Dedan (Gen 25:3). English convention: Letushim.
Qal/Pu: whet (Gen 4:22; 1Sam 13:20; Job 16:9; Ps 7:12; 52:2). Standard concordant.
Father of Palti (1Sam 25:44; 2Sam 3:15). English convention: Laish.
Place near Anathoth (Isa 10:30). English convention: Laishah.
Town in Judah (1Chr 4:21). English convention: Lecah.
Major Judean city (Josh 10:3-35; 12:11; 15:39; 2Kgs 14:19; 18:14,17; 19:8; 2Chr 11:9; 25:27; 32:9; Neh 11:30; Isa 36:2; 37:8; Jer 34:7; Mic 1:13). English convention: Lachish.
King of Massa (Prov 31:1,4). English convention: Lemuel. 'Belonging-to-Mighty-One'.
Cainite and father of Noah (Gen 4:18-19,23,24; 5:25-31; 1Chr 1:3). English convention: Lamech.
Ephraimite and Levite (1Chr 7:26; 23:7-9; 26:21). English convention: Ladan.
Bitter-herb (Deut 29:18; Prov 5:4; Jer 9:15; 23:15; Lam 3:15,19; Amos 5:7; 6:12). Standard concordant.
Gen 15:17; Ex 20:18; Judg 7:16,20; 15:4,5; Job 41:19; Isa 62:1; Eze 1:13; Dan 10:6; Nah 2:4; Zech 12:6. Standard concordant.
Husband of Deborah (Judg 4:4). English convention: Lapidoth.
Border-town of Naphtali (Josh 19:33). English convention: Lakkum.
Qal/Ni/Pu/Hophal/Hithp: take, receive, fetch (~966 occurrences spanning all OT — the second-most-frequent verb in Hebrew after H559 amar 'say'). Standard concordant 'take'.
Older name for Dan (Josh 19:47). English convention: Leshem.
Border-place of Canaan (Gen 10:19). English convention: Lasha.
Intensifier 'very, exceedingly' (~300 occurrences across all OT). Hyphenated.
Cardinal numeral hundred (~583 occurrences across all OT, mostly in census, chronological and measurement contexts). Standard concordant.
Tower in Jerusalem-wall (Neh 3:1; 12:39). English convention: Hammeah. 'Hundred'.
Bodily defect, ritual disqualifier (Lev 21:17,18,21,23; 22:20,21,25; 24:19,20; Num 19:2; Deut 15:21; 17:1; 32:5; 2Sam 14:25; Job 11:15; 31:7; Song 4:7; Dan 1:4). Hyphenated.
Noah's flood (Gen 6:17; 7:6,7,10,17; 9:11,15,28; 10:1,32; 11:10; Ps 29:10). Standard concordant 'Flood' (capitalized for the unique deluge-event).
Gen 23:6; Ex 15:4; Deut 12:11; 2Kgs 3:19; 19:23; Eze 24:4,5; 31:16. Standard concordant.
David's mighty man (1Chr 11:38). English convention: Mibhar.
David's mighty man (2Sam 23:27). English convention: Mebunnai.
Son of Ishmael (Gen 25:13; 1Chr 1:29; 4:25). English convention: Mibsam.
Place in Judah (Ezr 2:30). English convention: Magbish.
Major Canaanite-then-Israelite city (Josh 12:21; 17:11; Judg 1:27; 5:19; 1Kgs 4:12; 9:15; 2Kgs 9:27; 23:29,30; 1Chr 7:29; 2Chr 35:22; Zech 12:11). English convention: Megiddo.
Egyptian frontier-fortress (Ex 14:2; Num 33:7; Jer 44:1; 46:14; Eze 29:10; 30:6). English convention: Migdol.
Naphtali fortified-town (Josh 19:38). Hyphenated. English convention: Migdal-el.
Judean lowland-town (Josh 15:37). Hyphenated. English convention: Migdal-gad.
Place beyond Bethlehem (Gen 35:21; Mic 4:8). Hyphenated. English convention: Migdal-eder.
Son of Japheth, also northern people (Gen 10:2; 1Chr 1:5; Eze 38:2; 39:6). English convention: Magog.
Ps 31:13; Isa 31:9; Jer 6:25; 20:3,4,10; 46:5; 49:29; Lam 2:22. Standard concordant.
Ps 40:7; Jer 36:2-32; Eze 2:9; 3:1-3; Zech 5:1,2. Standard concordant.
Place near Gibeah (1Sam 14:2; Isa 10:28). English convention: Migron.
Levitical-pasture-belt around their cities (Lev 25:34; Num 35:2-7; Josh 14:4; 21:2-42; 1Chr 5:16; 6:55-81; 13:2; 2Chr 11:14; 31:19; Eze 27:28; 36:5; 45:2; 48:15,17). Hyphenated.
Uninhabited grazing-land, desert (~270 occurrences spanning all OT — pastoral-grazing, desert, location of Sinai-revelation, prophetic exile-and-restoration motif). Standard concordant 'wilderness'.
Member-of-Median people (2Kgs 17:6; 18:11; Ezr 6:2; Esth 1:19; Isa 13:17; Jer 25:25; 51:11,28; Dan 11:1). English convention: Mede.
Place in Judah (Josh 15:61). English convention: Middin.
Gentilic (Gen 37:28,36; Num 10:29; 25:6,14,15,17; 31:2,3; Josh 13:21; Judg 6:2,7,16; 7:23-25; 8:22). English convention: Midianite.
Place near Anathoth (Isa 10:31). English convention: Madmenah.
Town in Judah (Josh 15:31; 1Chr 2:49). English convention: Madmannah.
Son of Abraham by Keturah (Gen 25:2; 1Chr 1:32). English convention: Medan.
Variant for Midianite (Gen 37:36). English convention: Medanite.
Father of Haman (Esth 3:1,10; 8:5; 9:10,24). English convention: Hammedatha.
Interrogative 'what?, how?, why?' (~743 occurrences spanning all OT). Standard concordant.
